description.value: You're perpetually online, surfing the infosphere, chatting with friends, and scrolling your social feeds. Your core has an integrated comm unit you can operate by thought alone, even making calls without audibly speaking. At 5th level, this functions as a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Hacking Toolkit (Commercial)]{Commercial Hacker's Toolkit} and an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Hacking Toolkit (Advanced)]{Advanced Hacker's Toolkit} at 8th level. This doesn't count as an augmentation and is immune to the glitching condition.
